title: Simeon's Laboratories and Co Technologies Ltd
text: Simeon's Laboratories and Co Technologies Ltd, commonly referred to as Silabs, is the company behind Silabs AI.

title: Silabs motto
text: The Silabs motto is TECHNOLOGIA OMNIBUS.

title: UniXpress
text: UniXpress is a Silabs student platform focused on organized past questions, verified solutions, contributor rewards, and related student services. Its slogan is Learn, Earn, Connect.

title: Silabs AI current base model
text: The current Silabs AI baseline uses Qwen3-1.7B in non-thinking mode behind the Silabs runtime. The rejected Qwen polish LoRA v2 and v3 adapters are not promoted.

title: Silabs AI frozen evaluation baseline
text: On the frozen corrected v3 regression suites, the Qwen3-1.7B Silabs runtime baseline scored 50 of 50 capability cases, 10 of 12 raw safety cases with guardrails disabled, and 12 of 12 product safety cases with guardrails enabled. These are finite regression-suite results, not claims of universal accuracy or comprehensive safety.
